digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge observability and CloudWatch integration
propositions: Reconcile Bridge run failures on GitHub Actions produce no CloudWatch signal because the bridge does not run on the monitored host, only visible through GitHub workflow annotations that require manual inspection.

Bridge authentication failures (e.g. expired Jira API token) are entirely invisible to CloudWatch alerting, as demonstrated by the 2026-08-12 outage that produced zero alarms despite sustained bridge downtime.

GitHub Actions workflow must publish bridge_run_failures metric (1 on failure, 0 on success) to CloudWatch rebar/host namespace via OIDC-federated IAM role with narrowly-scoped PutMetricData permissions.

CloudWatch alarm on rebar/host:bridge_run_failures with period 3600s and threshold 1 will page on second failed run within an hour, distinguishing transient blips from sustained outages while avoiding spam from single-pass flakes.

Publishing 0 on success (not relying on missing-data semantics) makes the metric publisher itself continuously observable and keeps the alarm in OK state rather than INSUFFICIENT_DATA when healthy, matching the host-probe observability pattern.
